verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own iOS and Android apps, with features steadily added to them: document creation and editing, Diffs code review, line comments, and iterating with Linear Agent. It also supports starting work on mobile and continuing on desktop. Desktop parity is not evidenced, and features are announced as arriving on mobile over time, which suggests the mobile apps lag desktop. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of core issue/task management on mobile, documented feature parity with desktop, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality

citations.quote: Document creation and editing are now available in Linear's iOS and Android apps.
Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.
Diffs, Linear’s fast and focused review experience, is now available for iOS and Android.
Start on mobile, continue on desktop
